faq_items.question: Is there a new AI model called GPT-6 Astra?
faq_items.answer: Yes, GPT-6 Astra is the latest in a series of advanced AI models designed to enhance various applications.

faq_items.question: How does using Google AI Mode affect product prices compared to traditional search?
faq_items.answer: Using Google AI Mode can make products appear 21.6% more expensive than through traditional search methods.

faq_items.question: Are companies increasingly relying on open-source AI technologies?
faq_items.answer: Yes, many corporations are now integrating open-source AI into their operations, leveraging the flexibility and cost-effectiveness it offers.

faq_items.question: Can AI currently design circuit boards?
faq_items.answer: Research is ongoing, but current AI capabilities can assist in designing circuit boards, though full automation remains a challenge.

faq_items.question: What is TERMy and how does it differ from other AI tools?
faq_items.answer: TERMy is a terminal assistant that doesn't use large language models (LLMs), providing a different approach to enhancing command-line interfaces.
